records.literal_gloss: For the director, to the flutes. A psalm of David.

en.L: For the director: for the flutes. A psalm of David.
en.B: For the music director. For flutes. A psalm of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To be played on flutes. A song of David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : pour les flûtes. Un psaume de David.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Pour flûtes. Un psaume de David.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. À jouer sur des flûtes. Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya: kwa filimbi. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Kwa filimbi. Zaburi ya Daudi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Ipigwe kwa filimbi. Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro: para las flautas. Salmo de David.
es.B: Al director del coro. Para flautas. Salmo de David.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Para tocarse con flautas. Canto de David.

vi.L: Cho người chỉ huy [ban nhạc]: cho ống sáo. [Một] thi thiên của Đa-vít.
vi.B: Cho nhạc trưởng. Cho ống sáo. Thi thiên của Đa-vít.
vi.R: Cho người hướng dẫn ban nhạc. Để thổi bằng ống sáo. Bài ca của Đa-vít.

ko.L: 지휘자를 위하여. 피리에 맞추어. 다윗의 시.
ko.B: 음악 지휘자를 위하여. 피리에 맞추어. 다윗의 시.
ko.R: 찬양 인도자를 위해 피리로 연주하는, 다윗이 지은 노래.

pt.L: Para o regente: para as flautas. Salmo de Davi.
pt.B: Para o mestre de música. Para flautas. Salmo de Davi.
pt.R: Para quem dirige a música. Para ser tocado com flautas. Canção de Davi.

am.R: ለመዘምራን አለቃ። በዋሽንት የሚዘመር። ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር።

hi.L: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए: बाँसुरियों के लिए। दाऊद का भजन।
hi.B: संगीत-निर्देशक के लिए। बाँसुरियों के लिए। दाऊद का भजन।
hi.R: गायक-मंडली के अगुवे के लिए। बाँसुरियों पर बजाने के लिए। दाऊद का गीत।

ru.L: Руководителю хора: для флейт. Псалом Давида.
ru.B: Руководителю хора. Для флейт. Псалом Давида.
ru.R: Для руководителя музыкантов. Исполнять на флейтах. Песнь Давида.

ja.L: 指揮する者のために。笛に合わせて。ダビデの賛歌。
ja.B: 音楽を導く者のために。笛に合わせて。ダビデの賛歌。
ja.R: 音楽を導く人のために。笛で演奏する。ダビデの歌。

uk.L: Для диригента: для сопілок. Псалом Давида.
uk.B: Для диригента хору. Для сопілок. Псалом Давида.
uk.R: Для того, хто керує співом. Грати на сопілках. Пісня Давида.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 3, the title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
alternatives: for the end (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the flutes: an instrument or a tune
alternatives: a tune called 'Inheritances' (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The word (nechilot) occurs only here. It is usually linked with the word for a flute (chalil), so the psalm would be accompanied by flutes; it may instead be the name of a tune. The ancient Greek translation read it as "inheritances".

decisions.choice: song
decisions.reason: As in 3:1, Readable says what a psalm is.

decisions.choice: "ống sáo" for the flutes
alternatives: "Nê-hi-lốt" (the Hebrew word kept as a name)
decisions.reason: The English translates the word as flutes, so Vietnamese does too; the meaning decision notes that it may instead be the name of a tune.

decisions.choice: "피리에 맞추어" (for flutes)
alternatives: 느힐롯 (the Hebrew word kept as a name)
decisions.reason: The English takes the word as flutes; it may instead name a tune (meaning decision m3). Korean follows the English reading with the plain word for a wind instrument.

decisions.choice: for the flutes (ʾel-hanneḥilot) as "ለዋሽንቶች" (L), "በዋሽንት" (B), "በዋሽንት የሚዘመር" (R)
alternatives: leaving the word as a name
decisions.reason: The word is probably an instrument (meaning decision m3), and "ዋሽንት" is the Ethiopian flute; the terms list's heading table has no entry, so this is reported for the other Psalms.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

decisions.choice: "बाँसुरियों के लिए"
alternatives: a tune name, kept as a name
decisions.reason: The word may name an instrument or a tune (meaning m3); the English takes it as flutes, and the Hindi follows the English level, as the poetry note asks for these terms.

decisions.choice: 'el-hannechilot "笛に合わせて" (L, B), "笛で演奏する" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English reads it, an instrument; whether it is an instrument or a tune is uncertain (m3).

decisions.choice: "сопілки" for the flutes of the title
decisions.reason: The heading names a wind instrument; "сопілка" is the plain Ukrainian word for a simple pipe, as uncertain as the Hebrew term itself.

records.literal_gloss: My words give ear to, YHWH; consider my sighing.

en.L: To my words give ear, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; perceive my sighing.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hear what I say; take note of my sighs.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please listen to what I am saying. Pay attention to my quiet groans.

fr.L: À mes paroles prête l’oreille, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; discerne mon soupir.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, écoute ce que je dis ; prête attention à mes soupirs.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, écoute ce que je dis. Fais attention à mes plaintes murmurées.

sw.L: Uyategee sikio maneno yangu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q utambue kuugua kwangu.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, sikia ninayosema; \q uyaangalie maugulio yangu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, tafadhali sikiliza ninayosema. \q Uangalie jinsi ninavyougua kimya kimya.

es.L: A mis palabras presta oído, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; percibe mi suspiro.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, oye lo que digo; toma en cuenta mis suspiros.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por favor, escucha lo que digo. Presta atención a mis gemidos callados.

vi.L: Xin lắng tai nghe những lời của tôi, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q xin thấu hiểu tiếng than thở của tôi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin nghe những gì tôi nói; \q xin để ý đến tiếng thở than của tôi.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin hãy nghe những gì tôi đang nói. \q Xin để ý đến những tiếng rên rỉ khẽ của tôi.

ko.L: 제 말에 귀를 기울여 주십시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여. \q 제 탄식을 헤아려 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제 말을 들어 주십시오. \q 제 탄식에 마음을 써 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 제가 드리는 말씀을 들어 주십시오. \q 제 작은 신음 소리에 귀 기울여 주십시오.

pt.L: Às minhas palavras dá ouvidos, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}; percebe o meu suspiro.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, ouve o que eu digo; repara nos meus suspiros.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, por favor, escuta o que estou dizendo. Presta atenção aos meus gemidos baixinhos.

am.L: ለቃሌ ጆሮ ስጥ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፤ \q መቃተቴን አስተውል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ የምለውን ስማ፤ \q ቃተቴንም ልብ በል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እባክህ የምናገረውን አድምጥ። \q ቀስ ብዬ የማቃስተውንም ልብ በል።

hi.L: मेरे शब्दों पर कान लगा, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}; मेरी आहों को समझ।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरी बात सुन; मेरी आहों पर ध्यान दे।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, कृपया मेरी बात सुन। मेरे धीमे कराहने पर ध्यान दे।

ru.L: К словам моим склони ухо, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}; вникни в мой вздох.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, услышь, что я говорю; обрати внимание на мои вздохи.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, пожалуйста, выслушай, что я говорю. Обрати внимание на мои тихие стоны.

ja.L: わたしの言葉に耳を傾けてください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ。わたしのうめきを悟ってください。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの言うことを聞いてください。わたしのため息に心を留めてください。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、どうか、わたしの言うことを聞いてください。わたしの小さなうめき声に、気づいてください。

uk.L: Моїх слів послухай, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}; зрозумій моє зітхання.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, почуй, що я кажу; зверни увагу на мої зітхання.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, прошу, послухай, що я кажу. Зверни увагу на мої тихі стогони.

decisions.choice: sighing: a low groan or murmured prayer
decisions.reason: The word (hagig) is related to the verb for murmuring in 1:2 (hagah). It is the half-spoken prayer or groan of someone in trouble; Psalm 39:4 uses it for brooding thought.

decisions.choice: give ear, consider: three requests to be heard
decisions.reason: Verses 2-3 ask three times to be heard (give ear, consider, pay attention), a common way to open a prayer for help (Psalm 17:1).

decisions.choice: give ear
decisions.reason: The verb is formed from the word for ear; Literal shows the picture.

source.text: הַקְשִׁ֤יבָה׀לְק֬וֹל שַׁוְעִ֗י מַלְכִּ֥י וֵאלֹהָ֑י כִּֽי־אֵ֝לֶ֗יךָ אֶתְפַּלָּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: Attend to the sound of my cry for help, my king and my God, for to you I pray.

en.L: Pay attention to the sound of my cry for help, my King and my God, for to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I pray.
en.B: Listen to me crying for help, my King and my God, because it is to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} that I pray.
en.R: Hear me as I call for help, my King and my God. I am praying to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Sois attentif au son de mon cri au secours, mon Roi et mon Dieu, car vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je prie.
fr.B: Écoute-moi crier au secours, mon Roi et mon Dieu, car c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je prie.
fr.R: Entends-moi quand j’appelle au secours, mon Roi et mon Dieu. C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} que je prie.

sw.L: Isikilize sauti ya kilio changu cha kuomba msaada, \q Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu, \q kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ninaomba.
sw.B: Unisikilize ninapolia kuomba msaada, Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu, \q kwa sababu ni {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ninayekuomba.
sw.R: Unisikie ninapoita kuomba msaada, Mfalme wangu na Mungu wangu. \q Ninakuomba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.

es.L: Atiende a la voz de mi clamor, Rey mío y Dios mío, porque a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} oro.
es.B: Escúchame cuando clamo pidiendo ayuda, Rey mío y Dios mío, porque es a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} a quien oro.
es.R: Óyeme cuando pido ayuda, Rey mío y Dios mío. Estoy orando a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Xin chú ý đến tiếng kêu cứu của tôi, \q lạy Vua của tôi và Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, \q vì tôi cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin lắng nghe tôi kêu cứu, lạy Vua của tôi và Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, \q vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng tôi cầu nguyện.
vi.R: Lạy Vua của tôi và Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, xin nghe tôi kêu cứu. \q Tôi đang cầu nguyện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제가 도움을 청하여 부르짖는 소리에 귀 기울여 주십시오, \q 저의 왕, 저의 하나님. \q 제가 주님께 기도하기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 저의 왕, 저의 하나님, 도와 달라고 부르짖는 제 소리를 들어 주십시오. \q 제가 기도하는 분은 바로 주님이십니다.
ko.R: 저의 왕, 저의 하나님, 도와 달라고 외치는 저를 들어 주십시오. \q 저는 주님께 기도합니다.

pt.L: Atende à voz do meu clamor por socorro, meu Rei e meu Deus, porque a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} eu oro.
pt.B: Escuta o meu grito de socorro, meu Rei e meu Deus, porque é a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} que eu oro.
pt.R: Ouve quando eu peço ajuda, meu Rei e meu Deus. Estou orando a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: ንጉሤና አምላኬ ሆይ፣ \q የርዳታ ጩኸቴን ድምፅ አድምጥ፤ \q ወደ አንተ እጸልያለሁና።
am.B: ንጉሤና አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ርዳታ ለማግኘት ስጮኽ ስማኝ፤ \q የምጸልየው ወደ አንተ ነውና።
am.R: ንጉሤና አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ርዳታ ፍለጋ ስጣራ ስማኝ። \q ወደ አንተ እጸልያለሁ።

hi.L: मेरी दुहाई की आवाज़ पर ध्यान दे, हे मेरे राजा और मेरे परमेश्वर, क्योंकि मैं तुझी से प्रार्थना करता हूँ।
hi.B: हे मेरे राजा और मेरे परमेश्वर, मदद के लिए मेरी पुकार सुन, क्योंकि मैं तुझी से प्रार्थना करता हूँ।
hi.R: हे मेरे राजा और मेरे परमेश्वर, जब मैं मदद के लिए पुकारूँ तो मेरी सुन। मैं तुझसे प्रार्थना कर रहा हूँ।

ru.L: Прислушайся к звуку моего крика о помощи, Царь мой и Бог мой, ведь именно {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я молюсь.
ru.B: Услышь, как я кричу о помощи, мой Царь и мой Бог, потому что я молюсь {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.
ru.R: Услышь, как я зову на помощь, мой Царь и мой Бог. Я молюсь {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

ja.L: わたしの助けを求める叫びの声に、心を向けてください、わたしの王、わたしの神よ。あなたに、わたしは祈るのだから。
ja.B: わたしの王、わたしの神よ、助けを求めて叫ぶわたしの声を聞いてください。わたしが祈るのは、あなたに向かってなのだから。
ja.R: わたしの王、わたしの神よ、助けを求めるわたしの声を聞いてください。わたしは、あなたに祈っている。

uk.L: Прислухайся до голосу мого благання про допомогу, мій Царю і мій Боже, бо до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я молюся.
uk.B: Послухай, як я кличу на допомогу, мій Царю і мій Боже, бо саме до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я молюся.
uk.R: Почуй мене, коли я кличу на допомогу, мій Царю і мій Боже. Я молюся до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

decisions.choice: my King and my God: the king's own King
decisions.reason: David, Israel's king, calls the LORD his King. The LORD is the true king of his people (1 Samuel 8:7; Psalm 24:7-10), and the human king rules under him.

decisions.choice: cry for help: a shout for rescue
decisions.reason: The word (shav'a) is a call for help in trouble (Exodus 2:23).

decisions.choice: King (capitalized)
decisions.reason: "King" is capitalized as a title of God, as "Lord" is.

decisions.choice: "Vua" capitalised for God as the psalmist's King
decisions.reason: David, himself a king, calls God his King (see the meaning decision); the capital shows it is a title for God, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Царь with a capital
decisions.reason: "Царь" is a title of God here, the king's own King (m1), and is capitalised like "Бог", as the English capitalises "King".

decisions.choice: malki ve'lohai "わたしの王、わたしの神よ" at every level
decisions.reason: Japanese has no capitals; the order and the vocative よ show the address, and the meaning decision (the king's own King) is kept by 王 and 神 side by side.

source.text: יְֽהוָ֗ה בֹּ֭קֶרתִּשְׁמַ֣ע קוֹלִ֑י בֹּ֥קֶר אֶֽעֱרָךְ־לְ֝ךָ֗ וַאֲצַפֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, [in the] morning you hear my voice; [in the] morning I arrange for you and watch.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [in the] morning {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hear my voice; [in the] morning I set [it] out before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and keep watch.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, at daybreak {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hear my voice. At daybreak I set everything out before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and keep watch.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, every morning {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hear me. Every morning I bring my requests to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and wait for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to answer.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [au] matin {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} entends ma voix ; [au] matin je [la] dispose devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et je guette.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dès l’aube {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} entends ma voix. Dès l’aube je prépare tout devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et je reste aux aguets.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, chaque matin {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’entends. Chaque matin je {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} présente mes demandes et j’attends que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} répondes.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, asubuhi unasikia sauti yangu; \q asubuhi ninapanga [maombi yangu] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kungoja kwa makini.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kunapopambazuka unasikia sauti yangu. \q Kunapopambazuka ninaweka kila kitu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na kukesha nikingoja.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila asubuhi unanisikia. \q Kila asubuhi ninakuletea maombi yangu na kungoja {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unijibu.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, [de] mañana {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} oyes mi voz; [de] mañana [la] presento delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} y quedo vigilante.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, al amanecer {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} oyes mi voz. Al amanecer pongo todo delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} y quedo vigilante.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cada mañana {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me oyes. Cada mañana {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} presento mis peticiones y espero {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} respuesta.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, [vào] buổi sáng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe tiếng tôi; \q [vào] buổi sáng tôi bày [lời cầu nguyện] ra trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và trông đợi.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, lúc rạng đông {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe tiếng tôi. \q Lúc rạng đông tôi bày mọi điều ra trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chờ trông.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mỗi buổi sáng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} nghe tiếng tôi. \q Mỗi buổi sáng tôi dâng những lời cầu xin lên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và chờ đợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trả lời.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 아침에 주님께서 제 목소리를 들으십니다. \q 아침에 제가 주님 앞에 [그것을] 차려 놓고 지켜봅니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 동틀 때 주님께서 제 목소리를 들으십니다. \q 동틀 때 제가 모든 것을 주님 앞에 차려 놓고 살피며 기다립니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 아침마다 주님께서 제 말을 들으십니다. \q 아침마다 저는 주님께 제 소원을 아뢰고, 주님께서 응답해 주시기를 기다립니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, [de] manhã {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ouves a minha voz; [de] manhã eu ponho [tudo] em ordem diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} e fico vigiando.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, ao romper do dia {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ouves a minha voz. Ao romper do dia eu ponho tudo diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} e fico de vigia.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, toda manhã {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me ouves. Toda manhã eu trago a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} os meus pedidos e espero que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} respondas.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በማለዳ ድምፄን ትሰማለህ፤ \q በማለዳ [ጸሎቴን] በፊትህ አቀርባለሁ፤ እጠባበቃለሁም።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጎሕ ሲቀድ ድምፄን ትሰማለህ። \q ጎሕ ሲቀድ ሁሉን በፊትህ አቀርባለሁ፤ እጠባበቃለሁም።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በየማለዳው ትሰማኛለህ። \q በየማለዳው ልመናዬን ወደ አንተ አቀርባለሁ፤ እስክትመልስልኝም እጠብቃለሁ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, भोर को तू मेरी आवाज़ सुनता है; भोर को मैं [उसे] तेरे सामने सजाकर रखता हूँ और ताकता रहता हूँ।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, पौ फटते ही तू मेरी आवाज़ सुनता है। पौ फटते ही मैं सब कुछ तेरे सामने रखता हूँ और राह देखता रहता हूँ।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, हर सुबह तू मेरी सुनता है। हर सुबह मैं अपनी विनतियाँ तेरे पास लाता हूँ और तेरे उत्तर की राह देखता हूँ।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, утром {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} слышишь мой голос; утром я раскладываю [всё] перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}} и высматриваю.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, на рассвете {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} слышишь мой голос. На рассвете я раскладываю всё перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}} и смотрю, ожидая.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, каждое утро {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} слышишь меня. Каждое утро я приношу {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} свои просьбы и жду, когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} ответишь.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、朝に、あなたはわたしの声を聞かれる。朝に、わたしはあなたの前に[それを]整え、待ち望む。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、夜明けに、あなたはわたしの声を聞いてくださる。夜明けに、わたしはすべてをあなたの前に整えて、見張りながら待つ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、毎朝、あなたはわたしの声を聞いてくださる。毎朝、わたしは願いごとをあなたに申し上げ、答えてくださるのを待つ。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, [уранці] {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} чуєш мій голос; [уранці] я викладаю [це] перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}} і чекаю.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, на світанку {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} чуєш мій голос. На світанку я викладаю все перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}} і чекаю.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, щоранку {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} чуєш мене. Щоранку я приношу {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} свої прохання й чекаю, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} відповіси.

decisions.choice: I arrange: I set out my prayer, or my sacrifice
decisions.reason: The verb ('arak) means to set in order. It is used of laying out a sacrifice on the altar (Leviticus 1:7-8) and of setting out a case in court (Job 23:4). Here it has no object, so it may be either, or a prayer offered like a morning sacrifice.

decisions.choice: keep watch: look out for an answer
decisions.reason: The verb (tsafah) is used of a lookout on a wall. Habakkuk 2:1 uses it of watching to see what the LORD will answer.

decisions.choice: morning: the time of the morning sacrifice and of help
decisions.reason: The day began with the morning offering (Exodus 29:39), and the morning is often the time when God's help comes (Psalm 46:6).

decisions.choice: bring my requests; wait for you to answer
decisions.reason: Readable takes the verb as prayer (m1) and says what the watching is for (m2).

decisions.choice: "सजाकर रखता हूँ" (L); "सब कुछ तेरे सामने रखता हूँ" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb means to set in order, a prayer or a sacrifice (meaning m1); Literal and Balanced leave the object open, as the English does, and Readable takes it as prayer.

decisions.choice: 'e'erokh-lekha "あなたの前に[それを]整え" (L), "すべてをあなたの前に整えて" (B), Readable as the English ("願いごとを…申し上げ")
decisions.reason: The object (a prayer or a sacrifice) is uncertain (m1), so Literal and Balanced say only "set out"; Readable follows the English Readable's requests, with the humble 申し上げる for the speaker's own act.

source.text: כִּ֤י׀לֹ֤א אֵֽל־חָפֵ֘ץ רֶ֥שַׁע׀אָ֑תָּה לֹ֖א יְגֻרְךָ֣ רָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: For not a God delighting [in] wickedness [are] you; not will sojourn with you evil.

en.L: For not a God delighting [in] wickedness [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; evil will not sojourn with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness; evil cannot be {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} guest.
en.R: You are not a God who enjoys what is wicked. No evil person can live near {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Car [{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’es] pas un Dieu qui se plaît à la méchanceté, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; le mal ne séjournera pas chez {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’es pas un Dieu qui se plaît à la méchanceté ; le mal ne peut pas être {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} hôte.
fr.R: Tu n’es pas un Dieu qui aime ce qui est mauvais. Aucune personne mauvaise ne peut vivre près de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} si Mungu apendezwaye na uovu; \q ubaya hautakaa pamoja {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} si Mungu anayefurahia uovu; \q ubaya hauwezi kuwa mgeni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Wewe si Mungu anayependa mambo maovu. \q Hakuna mtu mwovu anayeweza kukaa karibu {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no [eres] un Dios que se complace [en la] maldad; el mal no morará junto a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no eres un Dios que se agrade de la maldad; el mal no puede ser {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} huésped.
es.R: Tú no eres un Dios al que le guste lo malo. Ninguna persona malvada puede vivir cerca de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không phải [là] một Đức Chúa Trời ưa thích điều gian ác; \q điều ác sẽ không ở trọ với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không phải là Đức Chúa Trời vui thích điều gian ác; \q điều ác không thể làm khách của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài không phải là Đức Chúa Trời ưa thích điều gian ác. \q Không kẻ ác nào được sống gần {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 주님은 악을 기뻐하는 하나님이 아니시니, \q 악이 주님과 함께 머물지 못합니다.
ko.B: 주님은 악을 즐거워하시는 하나님이 아니십니다. \q 악은 주님의 손님이 될 수 없습니다.
ko.R: 주님은 악한 것을 좋아하시는 하나님이 아니십니다. \q 악한 사람은 누구도 주님 곁에서 살 수 없습니다.

pt.L: Porque não [és] um Deus que tem prazer na maldade, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}; o mal não se hospedará {{deity_pronoun:contigo|Contigo}}.
pt.B: Pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não és um Deus que tem prazer na maldade; o mal não pode ser {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} hóspede.
pt.R: Tu não és um Deus que gosta do que é mau. Nenhuma pessoa má pode morar perto de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: አንተ በክፋት ደስ የሚልህ አምላክ አይደለህምና፤ \q ክፉ ከአንተ ጋር አያድርም።
am.B: አንተ በክፋት የምትደሰት አምላክ አይደለህምና፤ \q ክፉ ነገር እንግዳህ ሊሆን አይችልም።
am.R: አንተ በክፉ ነገር የምትደሰት አምላክ አይደለህም። \q ክፉ ሰው በአጠገብህ ሊኖር አይችልም።

hi.L: क्योंकि तू दुष्टता से प्रसन्न होनेवाला परमेश्वर नहीं [है]; बुराई तेरे साथ नहीं टिकेगी।
hi.B: क्योंकि तू ऐसा परमेश्वर नहीं जो दुष्टता से प्रसन्न होता है; बुराई तेरी मेहमान नहीं हो सकती।
hi.R: तू ऐसा परमेश्वर नहीं है जिसे दुष्टता अच्छी लगे। कोई दुष्ट व्यक्ति तेरे पास नहीं रह सकता।

ru.L: Ведь не Бог, желающий нечестия, — {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}; не поселится у {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} злое.
ru.B: Ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — не тот Бог, которому нравится нечестие; зло не может быть {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} гостем.
ru.R: Ты не тот Бог, которому нравится злое. Ни один злой человек не может жить рядом с {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}.

ja.L: まことに、あなたは悪を喜ぶ神ではない。悪はあなたのもとに宿ることがない。
ja.B: あなたは、悪を喜ばれる神ではないからだ。悪は、あなたのもとに客として身を寄せることができない。
ja.R: あなたは、悪いことを好まれる神ではない。悪い人は、あなたのそばに住むことができない。

uk.L: Бо не Бог, що любить беззаконня, — {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}; зло не перебуватиме з {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}.
uk.B: Бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} не Бог, якому до вподоби нечестя; зло не може бути {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} гостем.
uk.R: Ти не той Бог, якому подобається зло. Жодна зла людина не може жити поруч із {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}.

decisions.choice: sojourn with you: stay as your guest
decisions.reason: The verb (gur) means to live somewhere as a guest or resident foreigner. Psalm 15:1 asks who may be a guest in the LORD's tent; evil may not.

decisions.choice: evil: evil, or an evil person
decisions.reason: The word (ra') can mean evil or an evil person; the next verses speak of evil people.

decisions.choice: No evil person
decisions.reason: Readable takes the word as a person (m2), as verse 6 continues.

decisions.choice: "तेरे साथ नहीं टिकेगी" (L); "तेरी मेहमान नहीं हो सकती" (B)
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for a sojourner, here staying as a guest (meaning m1). Literal says the plain "टिकना" (to stay), Balanced the guest.

decisions.choice: "悪を喜ぶ神ではない" (L) is left without a respect form because it says what God is not; B, R use the respect form (喜ばれる, 好まれる) in the positive phrase they negate
decisions.reason: A negated respect form 喜ばれない could read "cannot rejoice"; the Psalter keeps 〜られない out of God's negatives (Job, Proverbs).

source.text: לֹֽא־יִתְיַצְּב֣וּ הֽ֭וֹלְלִים לְנֶ֣גֶד עֵינֶ֑יךָ שָׂ֝נֵ֗אתָ כָּל־פֹּ֥עֲלֵי אָֽוֶן׃

records.literal_gloss: Not will take their stand [the] boasters before your eyes; you hate all doers of iniquity.

en.L: Boasters will not take their stand before {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} eyes; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hate all workers of iniquity.
en.B: Those who boast cannot stand in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} sight; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} hate all who practice evil.
en.R: Proud people cannot stand in front of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. You hate everyone who does evil.

fr.L: Les vantards ne se tiendront pas devant {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} yeux ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} hais tous ceux qui pratiquent l’iniquité.
fr.B: Ceux qui se vantent ne peuvent pas tenir sous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} regard ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} détestes tous ceux qui font le mal.
fr.R: Les orgueilleux ne peuvent pas se présenter devant {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Tu détestes tous ceux qui font le mal.

sw.L: Wenye majivuno hawatasimama mbele ya macho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unawachukia wote watendao uovu.
sw.B: Wenye kujivuna hawawezi kusimama machoni {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}}; \q unawachukia wote wanaotenda maovu.
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi hawawezi kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. \q Unamchukia kila mtu anayetenda maovu.

es.L: Los jactanciosos no se mantendrán delante de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} ojos; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} aborreces a todos los que hacen iniquidad.
es.B: Los que se jactan no pueden estar en pie ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} mirada; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} odias a todos los que practican el mal.
es.R: La gente orgullosa no puede estar delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Tú odias a todos los que hacen el mal.

vi.L: Những kẻ khoe khoang sẽ không đứng được trước mắt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ghét mọi kẻ làm điều gian ác.
vi.B: Những kẻ khoác lác không thể đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ghét tất cả những kẻ làm điều ác.
vi.R: Những kẻ kiêu ngạo không thể đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Ngài ghét mọi kẻ làm điều ác.

ko.L: 자랑하는 자들이 주님의 눈앞에 서지 못하고, \q 주님께서는 악을 행하는 모든 자를 미워하십니다.
ko.B: 뽐내는 자들은 주님 앞에 설 수 없습니다. \q 주님께서는 악을 일삼는 자들을 모두 미워하십니다.
ko.R: 교만한 사람들은 주님 앞에 설 수 없습니다. \q 주님께서는 악한 일을 하는 사람을 모두 미워하십니다.

pt.L: Os fanfarrões não se apresentarão diante dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} olhos; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} odeias todos os que fazem iniquidade.
pt.B: Os que se gabam não conseguem ficar de pé à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} vista; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} odeias todos os que praticam o mal.
pt.R: Os orgulhosos não conseguem ficar diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Tu odeias todos os que fazem o mal.

am.L: ትምክህተኞች በዓይኖችህ ፊት አይቆሙም፤ \q ዓመፅን የሚሠሩትን ሁሉ ትጠላለህ።
am.B: የሚታበዩ በፊትህ ሊቆሙ አይችሉም፤ \q ክፉ የሚያደርጉትን ሁሉ ትጠላለህ።
am.R: ትዕቢተኞች በፊትህ መቆም አይችሉም። \q ክፉ የሚያደርገውን ሁሉ ትጠላለህ።

hi.L: घमंड करनेवाले तेरी आँखों के सामने खड़े न रहेंगे; तू सब अधर्म के काम करनेवालों से घृणा करता है।
hi.B: डींग मारनेवाले तेरी दृष्टि में टिक नहीं सकते; तू सब बुराई करनेवालों से घृणा करता है।
hi.R: घमंडी लोग तेरे सामने खड़े नहीं हो सकते। तू हर बुरा काम करनेवाले से घृणा करता है।

ru.L: Хвастуны не устоят перед {{deity_pronoun:твоими|Твоими}} глазами; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} ненавидишь всех, кто творит неправду.
ru.B: Хвастуны не могут стоять у {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} на виду; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} ненавидишь всех, кто делает зло.
ru.R: Гордые люди не могут стоять перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}. Ты ненавидишь всех, кто делает зло.

ja.L: 高ぶる者たちは、あなたの目の前に立つことがない。あなたは、悪を行う者たちをみな憎まれる。
ja.B: 誇り高ぶる者たちは、あなたの前に立つことができない。あなたは、悪を行う者たちをみな憎まれる。
ja.R: いばっている人たちは、あなたの前に立つことができない。あなたは、悪いことをする人たちを、みな憎まれる。

uk.L: Хвальки не встоять перед {{deity_pronoun:твоїми|Твоїми}} очима; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} ненавидиш усіх, хто чинить беззаконня.
uk.B: Ті, хто хвалиться, не встоять перед {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} поглядом; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} ненавидиш усіх, хто чинить зло.
uk.R: Горді люди не можуть стояти перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}. Ти ненавидиш кожного, хто чинить зло.

decisions.choice: take their stand: stand before God, or against him
decisions.reason: It is the verb of 2:2, where kings "take their stand" against the LORD. The boastful cannot present themselves before him, as a person stands before a king.

decisions.choice: boasters: the arrogant who brag
decisions.reason: The word (holelim) describes people who boast and act like fools in their pride (Psalm 73:3).

decisions.choice: you hate: God firmly rejects them
decisions.reason: God's hatred is not a passing feeling but his settled rejection of evil and of those who devote themselves to it. The psalm is not about personal dislike; it says who may come into God's presence.

decisions.choice: los que hacen iniquidad (L); los que practican el mal (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "workers of iniquity" are people whose habit is to do wrong. Literal keeps "iniquidad", Balanced and Readable say "el mal", as the English moves from "iniquity" to "evil".

decisions.choice: po'alei 'awen "悪を行う者たち" (L, B), "悪いことをする人たち" (R); for the Psalter
decisions.reason: As Proverbs 10:29 (po'ale 'awen 悪を行う者たち).

decisions.choice: "ті, хто чинить беззаконня" (L), "ті, хто чинить зло" (B, R) for the workers of iniquity, through the book
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the word iniquity; Balanced and Readable say what such people do.

source.text: תְּאַבֵּד֮ דֹּבְרֵ֪י כָ֫זָ֥ב אִישׁ־דָּמִ֥ים וּמִרְמָ֗ה יְתָ֘עֵ֥ב׀יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: You destroy speakers of falsehood; [a] man of blood and deceit YHWH abhors.

en.L: You destroy speakers of lies; {{gender:a person|a man}} of bloodshed and deceit {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} abhors.
en.B: You bring liars to ruin. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} loathes those who shed blood and deceive.
en.R: You destroy people who lie. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} hates people who kill and trick others.

fr.L: Tu fais périr ceux qui disent le mensonge ; {{gender:la personne|l’homme}} de sang et de fraude, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a en horreur.
fr.B: Tu mènes les menteurs à leur perte. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a en horreur ceux qui versent le sang et qui trompent.
fr.R: Tu détruis les gens qui mentent. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déteste ceux qui tuent et qui trompent les autres.

sw.L: Unawaangamiza wasemao uongo; \q mtu wa damu na hila {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} humchukia kabisa.
sw.B: Unawaletea maangamizi waongo. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawachukia kabisa wanaomwaga damu na kudanganya.
sw.R: Unawaangamiza watu wanaosema uongo. \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawachukia watu wanaoua na kuwadanganya wengine.

es.L: Destruyes a los que dicen mentiras; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} aborrece {{gender:a la persona|al hombre}} de sangre y de engaño.
es.B: Tú llevas a la ruina a los mentirosos. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} detesta a los que derraman sangre y engañan.
es.R: Tú destruyes a los que mienten. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} odia a los que matan y engañan a los demás.

vi.L: Ngài hủy diệt những kẻ nói dối; \q kẻ đổ máu và gian trá, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ghê tởm.
vi.B: Ngài làm cho kẻ nói dối bị diệt vong. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ghê tởm những kẻ làm đổ máu và lừa gạt.
vi.R: Ngài tiêu diệt những kẻ nói dối. \q {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ghét những kẻ giết người và lừa gạt người khác.

ko.L: 주님께서는 거짓을 말하는 자들을 멸하십니다. \q 피와 속임수의 사람을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 몹시 싫어하십니다.
ko.B: 주님께서는 거짓말하는 자들을 망하게 하십니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 피 흘리고 속이는 자들을 역겨워하십니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 거짓말하는 사람들을 없애십니다. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 사람을 죽이고 남을 속이는 사람들을 미워하십니다.

pt.L: Tu destróis os que falam mentiras; {{gender:a pessoa|o homem}} de sangue e de engano {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} abomina.
pt.B: Tu levas à ruína os mentirosos. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} detesta os que derramam sangue e enganam.
pt.R: Tu destróis as pessoas que mentem. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} odeia quem mata e engana os outros.

am.L: ሐሰትን የሚናገሩትን ታጠፋለህ፤ \q ደም የሚያፈስሰውንና አታላዩን ሰው {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይጸየፋል።
am.B: ውሸታሞችን ታጠፋለህ። \q ደም የሚያፈስሱትንና የሚያታልሉትን {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይጸየፋቸዋል።
am.R: የሚዋሹ ሰዎችን ታጠፋለህ። \q ሰው የሚገድሉትንና ሌሎችን የሚያታልሉትን ሰዎች {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ይጠላቸዋል።

hi.L: तू झूठ बोलनेवालों को नष्ट करता है; रक्तपात और छल करनेवाले {{gender:व्यक्ति|आदमी}} से {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} घृणा करते हैं।
hi.B: तू झूठों को विनाश में डालता है। जो ख़ून बहाते और छल करते हैं, उनसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} घिन करते हैं।
hi.R: तू झूठ बोलनेवालों को नष्ट कर देता है। जो लोग हत्या करते और दूसरों को धोखा देते हैं, उनसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} घृणा करते हैं।

ru.L: Ты уничтожаешь говорящих ложь; человека крови и обмана {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} гнушается.
ru.B: Ты губишь лжецов. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} гнушается теми, кто проливает кровь и обманывает.
ru.R: Ты уничтожаешь людей, которые лгут. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} ненавидит тех, кто убивает и обманывает других.

ja.L: あなたは偽りを語る者たちを滅ぼされる。血を流す者と欺く者を、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は忌み嫌われる。
ja.B: あなたは、うそを言う者たちを滅ぼされる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、血を流す者と欺く者を、忌み嫌われる。
ja.R: あなたは、うそをつく人たちを滅ぼされる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、人を殺す人や人をだます人を、ひどく嫌われる。

uk.L: Ти губиш тих, хто говорить неправду; {{gender:кровожерливою й підступною людиною|кровожерливим і підступним чоловіком}} гидує {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}.
uk.B: Ти доводиш брехунів до загибелі. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} гидує тими, хто проливає кров і обманює.
uk.R: Ти знищуєш людей, які брешуть. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} ненавидить тих, хто вбиває й ошукує інших.

decisions.choice: man of blood: someone who sheds blood, a violent person
decisions.reason: A "man of blood" is a murderer or a violent person (2 Samuel 16:7). Deceit (mirmah) is the trickery that goes with it.

decisions.choice: the LORD abhors: from "you" to "the LORD"
decisions.reason: The psalmist speaks to God ("you destroy") and then about him ("the LORD"), a shift common in the Psalms.

decisions.choice: a person, with "a man" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The phrase describes anyone who is violent and deceitful, so the gender setting gives inclusive wording; Balanced and Readable say "those" and "people".

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} aborrece {{gender:a la persona|al hombre}}
alternatives: a la persona ... la aborrece el SEÑOR
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts the person first and "the LORD abhors" last. Literal Spanish puts the LORD first so that the gender setting changes only "a la persona" and "al hombre"; with the Hebrew order the pronoun after it would have to change too.

decisions.choice: "kẻ đổ máu" with no gender span
alternatives: a gender span as in the English ("a person"/"a man")
decisions.reason: "kẻ" already means anyone, man or woman, so Vietnamese has no second form for the setting to switch to, as in Psalm 139:19.

decisions.choice: "피와 속임수의 사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" already means a person of either sex and is the natural word here, so Korean has no second wording to offer for the English "a person|a man" span (style guide section 7). The same holds wherever the English has a gender span on a word Korean says inclusively in Psalms 5-25.

decisions.choice: "ሰው" (a person) with no gender span
alternatives: a span like the English one
decisions.reason: Amharic "ሰው" covers man and woman, and the generic masculine that follows in 5:13 is inclusive, so the setting has nothing to change in this psalm.

decisions.choice: "तू" and then honorific "घृणा करते हैं"
decisions.reason: The psalm turns from speaking to God to speaking about him (meaning m2); the Hindi turns with it from "तू" to the honorific third person, as the poetry note has it.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:व्यक्ति|आदमी}}"
decisions.reason: As the English, and as at 1:1, the phrase describes anyone violent and deceitful. Balanced and Readable say "those who", with no span. In verse 13, the Hindi "उसे" is the same for a man or a woman, so the Hindi needs no span where the English Literal has one.

decisions.choice: человека, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal offers "a person" and "a man" through the gender setting; Russian "человек" already includes everyone who is violent and deceitful, so it needs no setting, as in the Russian New Testament.

decisions.choice: 'ish damim umirmah "血を流す者と欺く者" with no gender span
decisions.reason: 者 already covers anyone, so the English span (a person / a man) is not needed.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֗י בְּרֹ֣ב חַ֭סְדְּךָ אָב֣וֹא בֵיתֶ֑ךָ אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה אֶל־הֵֽיכַל־קָ֝דְשְׁךָ֗ בְּיִרְאָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: But I, in [the] abundance of your loyal love, will enter your house; I will bow down toward [the] temple of your holiness in fear of you.

en.L: But I, in [the] abundance of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, will enter {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house; I will bow down toward [the] temple of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holiness in fear of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: But I, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love is so great, will come into {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house; in awe of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I will bow down toward {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple.
en.R: But because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} love is so great and so faithful, I will come into {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house. I will bow down toward {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple, full of respect for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Mais moi, dans [l’]abondance de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, j’entrerai dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison ; je me prosternerai vers [le] temple de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sainteté dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} crainte.
fr.B: Mais moi, parce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle est si grand, j’entrerai dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison ; rempli de respect pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, je me prosternerai vers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint temple.
fr.R: Mais parce que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour est si grand et si fidèle, j’entrerai dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison. Je me prosternerai vers {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} temple saint, plein de respect pour {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

sw.L: Lakini mimi, kwa wingi wa upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, nitaingia nyumbani {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}; \q nitasujudu kuelekea hekalu la utakatifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa kukucha.
sw.B: Lakini mimi, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ni mkuu sana, nitaingia nyumbani {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}; \q kwa kukucha nitasujudu kuelekea hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu.
sw.R: Lakini kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma ni mkuu sana, nitaingia nyumbani {{deity_pronoun:mwako|Mwako}}. \q Nitasujudu kuelekea hekalu {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu, nikiwa na heshima kuu {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}}.

es.L: Pero yo, por [la] abundancia de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, entraré en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa; me postraré hacia [el] templo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santidad con temor de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
es.B: Pero yo, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel es tan grande, entraré en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa; con reverencia ante {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me inclinaré hacia {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo templo.
es.R: Pero como {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor es tan grande y tan fiel, entraré en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa. Me inclinaré hacia {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo templo, lleno de respeto por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

vi.L: Nhưng tôi, nhờ [sự] dư dật của tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ vào nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q tôi sẽ cúi lạy hướng về đền thờ của sự thánh khiết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong sự kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nhưng tôi, nhờ tình yêu thương thành tín lớn lao của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, sẽ được vào nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q với lòng kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi sẽ cúi lạy hướng về đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật lớn lao, tôi sẽ vào nhà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Tôi sẽ cúi lạy hướng về đền thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lòng đầy tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 저는 주님의 풍성한 한결같은 사랑으로 주님의 집에 들어가겠습니다. \q 주님을 경외하며 주님의 거룩함의 성전을 향하여 엎드리겠습니다.
ko.B: 그러나 저는 주님의 한결같은 사랑이 크시기에 주님의 집에 들어가겠습니다. \q 주님을 경외하며 주님의 거룩한 성전을 향해 엎드려 절하겠습니다.
ko.R: 그러나 주님의 변함없는 사랑이 크시기에 저는 주님의 집에 들어가겠습니다. \q 주님을 깊이 존경하는 마음으로 주님의 거룩한 성전을 향해 엎드리겠습니다.

pt.L: Mas eu, pela abundância do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, entrarei na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} casa; eu me prostrarei voltado para o templo da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} santidade, com temor de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.
pt.B: Mas eu, porque o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal é tão grande, entrarei na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} casa; com reverência diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, eu me curvarei voltado para o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} templo santo.
pt.R: Mas, como o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor é tão grande e tão fiel, eu vou entrar na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} casa. Vou me curvar voltado para o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} templo santo, cheio de respeito por {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}.

am.L: እኔ ግን በጽኑ ፍቅርህ ብዛት ወደ ቤትህ እገባለሁ፤ \q አንተን በመፍራት ወደ ቅድስናህ መቅደስ እሰግዳለሁ።
am.B: እኔ ግን ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ታላቅ ስለ ሆነ ወደ ቤትህ እገባለሁ፤ \q አንተን በመፍራት ወደ ቅዱስ መቅደስህ እሰግዳለሁ።
am.R: እኔ ግን ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ታላቅ ስለ ሆነ ወደ ቤትህ እመጣለሁ። \q አንተን በማክበር ወደ ቅዱስ መቅደስህ እሰግዳለሁ።

hi.L: पर मैं, तेरे अटल प्रेम की बहुतायत से, तेरे भवन में प्रवेश करूँगा; मैं तेरे भय में तेरी पवित्रता के मन्दिर की ओर दंडवत करूँगा।
hi.B: पर मैं, तेरे अटल प्रेम की महानता के कारण, तेरे भवन में आऊँगा; तेरे प्रति श्रद्धा और भय में मैं तेरे पवित्र मन्दिर की ओर झुककर दंडवत करूँगा।
hi.R: पर तेरा अटल प्रेम इतना महान है कि मैं तेरे भवन में आऊँगा। तेरा गहरा आदर करते हुए मैं तेरे पवित्र मन्दिर की ओर झुककर दंडवत करूँगा।

ru.L: А я — по обилию {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви — войду в {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} дом; я поклонюсь, [обратившись] к храму {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} святости, в страхе перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}.
ru.B: А я, потому что {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} неизменная любовь так велика, войду в {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} дом; в благоговении перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}} я поклонюсь, обратившись к {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} святому храму.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} неизменная любовь так велика, что я могу прийти в {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} дом. Я поклонюсь, обратившись к {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} святому храму, с глубоким почтением к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

ja.L: しかしわたしは、あなたの誠実の豊かさによって、あなたの家に入り、あなたを恐れつつ、あなたの聖なる神殿に向かってひれ伏す。
ja.B: しかしわたしは、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみが豊かなので、あなたの家に入り、あなたを畏れつつ、あなたの聖なる神殿に向かってひれ伏す。
ja.R: しかし、あなたの変わらぬいつくしみは、とても大きい。だから、わたしはあなたの家に入る。あなたを心からおそれ敬い、あなたの聖なる神殿に向かってひれ伏す。

uk.L: А я, з великої {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} незмінної любові, увійду в {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} дім; я вклонюся до храму {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} святості в страху перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}}.
uk.B: А я, бо така велика {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} незмінна любов, увійду в {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} дім; у благоговінні перед {{deity_pronoun:тобою|Тобою}} я вклонюся до {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} святого храму.
uk.R: Але завдяки {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} такій великій і вірній любові я ввійду в {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} дім. Я вклонюся до {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} святого храму, сповнений пошани до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}.

decisions.choice: loyal love: love that keeps faith
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is love that stays loyal to a relationship and a promise: the LORD's love for his people, "abounding in loyal love and faithfulness" (Exodus 34:6). The faithful one of 4:4 (chasid) is a person who shows the same loyalty.

decisions.choice: But I, in the abundance of your loyal love: only by God's love
decisions.reason: The psalmist sets himself apart from the boasters who cannot stand before God, but he comes in only because of God's great love, not because of his own goodness.

decisions.choice: your house, your holy temple: the place of worship
decisions.reason: The house and temple (hekal, a palace or temple) are where the LORD is worshiped. In David's time this was the tent that housed the ark (2 Samuel 6:17); the tent at Shiloh is also called a temple (1 Samuel 1:9; 3:3).

decisions.choice: loyal love
decisions.reason: "Loyal love" says both that it is love and that it keeps faith (m1). Readable says "so great and so faithful".

decisions.choice: in awe of you
decisions.reason: The fear is reverence (as in 2:11); Literal keeps "fear".

decisions.choice: ḥesed: "amour loyal" (Literal), "amour fidèle" (Balanced, Readable), for this block of psalms
decisions.reason: The word is love that keeps faith with a commitment (m1). "Bonté" and "miséricorde" say only part of it. Literal pairs the noun with "loyal" as the English does; Balanced and Readable use the more natural "fidèle".

decisions.choice: "upendo usiokoma" (love that never ends) for hesed at every level, through the Psalms; "fadhili" where the English says "kindness"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew hesed is love that keeps faith and does not give up (m1). "Upendo usiokoma" says both love and faithfulness in words every reader knows; "fadhili" (kindness, favour) is kept for the places where the English also narrows the word to kindness. Readable has the same words, as the English Readable's "so great and so faithful" says.

decisions.choice: amor leal (L); amor fiel (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew hesed is love that keeps faith with a bond. Literal says "amor leal", Balanced and Readable "amor fiel", the same in every psalm; "misericordia", the older rendering, says pity rather than loyalty.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B); "tình thương không hề thay đổi" (R), as Psalm 23:6
decisions.reason: The word is love that keeps faith (see the meaning decision). The terms note fixes these forms for the whole book, as the published Psalm 23:6 has them; "lòng nhân từ" stays for the places where the English says "kindness".

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R) for chesed
decisions.reason: Terms note and the published Psalm 23:6: the word is love that keeps faith (meaning decision m1); "인자하심" is the older church word, now unclear to many readers, and "자비" says only mercy. The same words stand for chesed through Psalms 5-25.

decisions.choice: amor leal (L, B); o teu amor é tão grande e tão fiel (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: chesed is "amor leal" (m1), as Exodus 34:6 and the refrain of 1 Chronicles 16:34 have it in Portuguese ("porque o seu amor leal dura para sempre"), which Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136 repeat. "Misericórdia" and "graça" are the traditional words, but they say pity or undeserved favor, not love that keeps faith. Readable follows the English Readable here; where it says "loyal love", Readable says "amor leal" too.

decisions.choice: loyal love (ḥesed) as "ጽኑ ፍቅር" at every level
decisions.reason: The terms list keeps "ጽኑ ፍቅር" for ḥesed through the Psalter, Readable included, for the English "love so great and so faithful".

decisions.choice: "अटल प्रेम" at every level
decisions.reason: God's hesed, love that keeps faith (meaning m1), is "अटल प्रेम" at every level of the psalms, as the poetry note settles; Readable keeps it where the English says "so great and so faithful", since "अटल" already says the faithfulness.

decisions.choice: "मन्दिर"
decisions.reason: The word is hekhal, the temple or palace of God (meaning m3), "मन्दिर" as the history note settles; "भवन" is the house.

decisions.choice: неизменная любовь at every level
decisions.reason: The Psalms terms note settles God's hesed as "неизменная любовь" at every level: love that keeps faith (m1). Readable says "так велика" for the abundance, where the English Readable says "so great and so faithful".

decisions.choice: chesed of God "誠実" (L), "変わらぬいつくしみ" (B, R); for the whole Psalter
decisions.reason: The forms of the refrain of 1 Chronicles 16:34 (= Psalms 106:1, 107:1, 118, 136), which the Psalter repeats; Literal 誠実 keeps the link with chesed between people and with chasid (4:4).

decisions.choice: "незмінна любов" (L, B), "вірна любов" (R) for hesed, through the book
decisions.reason: Hesed is love that keeps faith; "милість" alone sounds like pity or favour shown from above. The refrains and Psalm 136 keep the same words.
